newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Lehman Bros sets Electrolux goal 630 skr.
newsitem.headline: Lehman Bros sets Electrolux goal 630 skr.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Lehman Brothers said on Friday it had a target price of 630 crowns for shares in appliance maker Electrolux in the medium term.
"Considering the assets in the company the share is undervalued. We have a target price in the medium term of 630 crowns," Lehman Brothers analyst Chris Heminway told Reuters.
Electrolux said on Thursday it would close about 25 of 150 plants and cut 12,000 staff from a workforce of 105,000 in a 2.5 billion crown restructuring programme.
"Before yesterday's announcement Electrolux was valued at 145 percent of capital employed compared with an average of 185 percent for European manufacturing companies."
"If Electrolux succeeds it could be reasonable for it to reach the average for European manufacturing companies," Heminway said.
"This programme doesn't guarantee that the company reaches that. There will be risks but also possibilities for positive surprises.
"This restructuring programme doesn't, for example, take into account positive effects from an upturn in the business cycle," he said.
Electrolux was added to the European strategy "recommended" list at Lehman Brothers, replacing Atlas Copco, the investment bank said on Friday.
